definitions.eye-line: Midpoint of the two visible eye-line centers. Operational observation is the average of medial/lateral visible eyelid-line endpoints for each eye;exclude extra eyelash tips and pupil/gaze position. Closed lids use visible crease endpoints;occluded endpoint stays null.
definitions.visible-paw: Midpoint of axis-aligned visible paw+digits bounding rectangle clipped at the visible sleeve opening;include all visible exposed appendage between sleeve and digits. Occluding cloth clips the visible extent;never infer hidden wrist/palm anatomy.
